KEY FEATURES:
• Packaging reduced by 45% for less waste
• 100-card ready-to-play Streets of New Capenna Commander deck
• 2-card Collector Booster Sample Pack—2 special treatment cards in every pack
• Includes 2 traditional foils + 98 nonfoil cards
• 1 foil-etched Display Commander, 10 double-sided tokens + life tracker
• Introduces 2 foil + 15 nonfoil MTG cards not found in the main set

DESCRIPTION:
This minimally-packaged version of the Obscura Operation Streets of New Capenna Commander Deck includes all the same contents but with less packaging waste. Each box contains 1 ready-to-play White-Blue-Black deck of 100 Magic cards (2 traditional foil, 98 nonfoil), a 2-card Collector Booster Sample Pack, 1 foil-etched Display Commander (a thick cardstock copy of the commander card with foil etched into the card’s border and art), 10 double-sided tokens, 1 counter punchout card, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), 1 life tracker, and 1 reference card. Every Collector Booster Sample Pack contains 1 traditional foil Showcase Uncommon or Common card and 1 traditional foil or nonfoil alternate treatment card of rarity Rare or higher).
